newsitem.title: USA: Badger Meter plans $8 million expansion.
newsitem.headline: Badger Meter plans $8 million expansion.

text.p: Badger Meter Inc, a maker of products using flow measurement and control technology, said Monday it plans to build a 52,000-square foot addition to its headquarters and manufacturing facility in Brown Deer, Wisconsin.
The addition will house a new engineering laboratory and design facility and expanded manufacturing operations, the company said.
Construction is expected to begin in August and is scheduled for completion in early 1999, the company said.
Badger Meter shares were up 1/4 at 29-7/8 Monday.
